description: Phase 1b step 3: the Adams-variant fit (docs/notes/P1B_adams_fit.md). Data set D (Table 77 minus Flamsteed 1690, Paris 1801-1827 and rows after 1840), three fits (a held at 38.4 and 37.25 AU, a free) under Gaussian and Student-t (nu 4) errors; M6c's observation model, priors and sampler. ln Z errors x err_inflation.
